description: Original chibi enemy tank viewed from above, with a rounded red hull and rotating turret.

features: six road wheels on each side
vehicle.orientation: front points to the top edge in forward, firing and explosion sheets
vehicle.styleNote: Original colorful tower-defense cartoon; not a reproduction of any named game vehicle.

sheets.notes: Heavy forward travel; six road wheels and tread links rotate, hull bobs, small rear exhaust puffs.
Stationary hull; turret and barrel rotate through eight 45-degree steps, looping through 360 degrees.
One heavy cannon shot; bright muzzle burst, tank recoil, brass casing and expanding muzzle smoke.
Intact tank, turret fire, comic blast, flying turret with heavy smoke, burning wreck with scattered track links, charcoal remains; hold frame 6.

construct3.import: Import each PNG as a sprite and set animation frame size to 64x64.
construct3.frameOrder: Frames are arranged left-to-right, starting at zero in the image editor.
construct3.turretRotate: Eight frames at 45 degrees per frame; loop after frame 8.
construct3.oneShot: Shoot and explosion are one-shot; hold explosion frame 6.
construct3.motionBlur: No motion blur; tank links and details remain crisp.
